external_games.name: Dark Dice: Cthulhu Investigation Log - Expansion Pack (The Lost Case Files)

name: Dark Dice: The Lost Case Files
summary: 35 new investigations adapted from H.P. Lovecraft, from the Dreamlands to Federal Hill. A new way to play: hunt down six key relics to open each case's final door, while every lead you chase closes another. Win allies, make rivals, and face up to eight endings.
